baseline.source: Owner-approved Scenario 01 input and expected structure, plus explicitly declared synthetic resolutions in the initiative evaluation record.
baseline.limitation: L0 was normalized for this pilot after L1 already existed. L1 was not newly generated from this exact L0; the pilot cannot attribute L0-to-L2 loss to a new generator invocation.

renderer.integration: Pinned local browser runtime, not draw.io Desktop

workers.scenario_input: L2 only, plus generic drawing conventions/catalog/validator/renderer
L0/L2/L4 and generic grading contract only; later scope-calibration feedback

isolation: Fresh conversation launches observed through host agent tools. Workers were instructed not to inspect other task artifacts and attested their sources. Shared filesystem access was not sandboxed per worker.
model: Inherited host session model; exact identity and generation parameters were not exposed by the worker interface. No separately configured NVIDIA or other remote endpoint was invoked.
transcription: Reader responses were serialized as plain UTF-8 text with normalized quotation marks/whitespace; artifact attestations were separated. No architectural content was edited. Judge source strings match those frozen files byte-for-byte.
calibration: The first judge over-counted incidental comment placement, diagnostic absence observations and literal wording differences. Scope review removed those false positives and interpreted whole enumerations/examples semantically, without changing L0/L2/L4 or either diagram. Initial judgment remains in ignored task scratch; final grounded ledgers are selected evidence here.
automation_limit: Workers were launched by the app agent tools. The reusable executeRoundTrip adapter contract is unit-tested, but this live pilot was host-orchestrated rather than run by a configured unattended local model adapter.
